Name: SmartFishing
Author: betterlch
Description:
[b][color=#d4d4d8][size=4]Description 简介[/size][/color][/b]
[color=#D4D4D8]
A fishing automation mod with three features: enchantment-free auto-hook, a level-aware minigame skip with a transparent perfect/quality model, and an auto-recast that repeats the player's last cast.

一款钓鱼自动化模组，包含三项功能：不占锻造槽的自动上钩、基于等级模型的跳过小游戏、复刻玩家上次抛竿的自动连抛。

[b][size=4]Features 功能[/size][/b]

[b]Auto-hook 自动上钩[/b]
• Reels in automatically the instant a fish bites, using the same mechanic as the vanilla Auto-Hook enchantment without occupying the forge slot
• Reel timing: Immediate or Realistic (short random delay)[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]/[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
• 鱼咬钩瞬间自动收竿，与原版 Auto-Hook 附魔机制相同，但不占用锻造附魔槽
• 收竿时机可选：立即 / 拟人（随机短暂延迟）

[b]Skip minigame 跳过小游戏[/b]
• Simulated mode: skips the minigame and determines "perfect" from a difficulty model based on the fish's difficulty and behavior, the player's fishing level, rod, tackle, daily luck and treasure; quality follows the vanilla upgrade pipeline with a level-scaled tier bonus
• Also provides Always perfect and Disabled modes[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]/[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
• 拟真模拟：跳过小游戏后按难度模型判定是否完美（基于鱼类难度与行为、玩家钓鱼等级、鱼竿、浮标、每日运气、宝箱）；品质按原版升档管线结算，并附加基于等级的品质提升概率
• 另有"必完美"与"关闭"两种模式

[b]Auto-recast 自动连抛[/b]
• Repeats the player's last cast with identical power and direction, including mid-flight steering; a fixed power tier (1-5) and a maximum power cap are also available
• Stops on direction keys, left/right click, Esc, a configurable key, tool switching, low stamina, a full inventory, or a cast landing off-water[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]/[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
• 以相同的力度与方向复刻玩家上次抛竿，包含斜抛落点；可选固定档位（1-5 档）与力度上限
• 停止方式：方向键、左键、右键、Esc、自定义按键、切换工具、体力阈值、背包已满、抛竿落水失败

[b]Catch information 钓获信息[/b]
• Shows what can be caught at the current bobber and with which probabilities, sampled from the game's own fish selection logic
• Displays the fish, final quality and perfect state after each skipped catch
• Auto-loots and closes treasure windows, with a loot summary[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]/[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
• 显示当前钓点可捕获的鱼类及概率，采样自游戏自身的选鱼逻辑
• 跳过钓获后显示鱼名、最终品质与是否完美
• 宝箱界面自动拾取并关闭，并显示战利品摘要

[b][size=4]Installation 安装[/size][/b]

[b]1.[/b] Install SMAPI 4.0+
[b]2.[/b] Unzip and place the SmartFishing folder into the Mods directory (Vortex users can import the zip directly)
[b]3.[/b] Optional: install [url=https://www.nexusmods.com/stardewvalley/mods/5098]Generic Mod Config Menu[/url] for in-game configuration[/color]

[color=#D4D4D8]/[/color]
[color=#D4D4D8]
[b]1.[/b] 安装 SMAPI 4.0+
[b]2.[/b] 解压后将 SmartFishing 文件夹放入 Mods 目录（Vortex 用户可直接导入 zip）
[b]3.[/b] 可选：安装 GMCM 以在游戏内调整配置

[b][size=4]Notes 说明[/size][/b]

• Simplified Chinese included · 内置简体中文
• If used together with other fishing automation mods, disable their overlapping features to avoid conflicts · 如与其他钓鱼自动化模组同时使用，请关闭其重叠功能以避免冲突[/color]

Manifest.Name: SmartFishing
Manifest.Description: Enchantment-free auto-hook plus a level-aware perfect/quality model when skipping the fishing minigame. Never casts for you, never touches the forge slot.
Manifest.Author: lc
